title: Operations & Sales Coordinator
company: Streamline Services Consultancy Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Streamline Recruitment have a fantastic opportunity for an Operations & Sales Coordinator to join our client's well-established business based in East London.

Our client is one of the world's leading manufacturers and suppliers of wood veneer, veneer edging and veneered boards. For over 60 years, they have built an outstanding reputation across the industry.

Due to continued success, they are looking for an Operations & Sales Coordinator to join their close-knit team. This is a varied role where no two days are the same, offering the opportunity to work closely with customers, suppliers and logistics partners while playing an important role in ensuring orders are managed smoothly from enquiry through to delivery.

The Role

As the first point of contact for many customers, you will be responsible for managing customer orders, coordinating deliveries and supporting the wider sales and operations function. You will ensure all enquiries, quotations and orders are handled accurately, efficiently and with a strong focus on customer service.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing customer orders and managing them through to successful completion.
- Checking stock availability and liaising with internal teams.
- Reviewing customer enquiries and quotations, following up where appropriate.
- Coordinating deliveries with third-party logistics providers.
- Monitoring customer deliveries and resolving any issues quickly and professionally.
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with existing customers.
- Identifying opportunities to upsell products and support additional sales.
- Providing excellent customer service via telephone and email.
- Supporting the wider sales and operations team with day-to-day administration.

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- A confident communicator with strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
- Organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities.
- Experienced in customer service, sales support, order processing or a similar office-based role.
- Comfortable liaising with customers, suppliers and internal teams.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and CRM/ERP systems.
- Reliable, positive and willing to be part of a friendly, supportive team.

What's on Offer?
- Monday to Friday working hours 7:30am to 4:30pm
- £32-40k DOE
- 20 days holiday plus Bank Holidays (5 days reserved for the Christmas shutdown)
- The opportunity to join a successful family-run business with over 60 years of industry experience.
- Flexible and approachable management who value their employees.
- Long-term career stability and development opportunities.
- A varied role where you can genuinely make a difference every day.

If you're looking for a company where people genuinely enjoy coming to work, where teamwork is valued and your contribution is recognised, this could be the perfect opportunity.

You'll be joining a hardworking yet easy-going team who support one another and take pride in delivering exceptional service to their customers.

description:
Our client, a global business with a market leading reputation, is recruiting a Customer Experience Representative. This company are known for innovation, technical expertise and being an excellent employer.

This role is working for a global business based in Derbyshire. The role would initially be temporary for 12 months, but is highly likely to be extended beyond that and could in future become a permanent role.

title: Administrator
description:
Administrator
Tibshelf £26,436.80 - £28,000 DOE Permanent, Full Time

Before applying, please note this role requires:
- The right to work in the UK without employer sponsorship, now or in future
- A realistic daily commute to Mansfield, this is a fully site based role, five days a week, full time only (not suitable for part time)
- A solid, stable background in office administration, with genuine systems experience (Excel, databases, or similar), and a consistent employment history rather than frequent short term moves

If that sounds like you, read on.

The Company

Our client is a well established international manufacturer with a strong reputation for quality and innovation, supplying equipment and fitted solutions to commercial and retail customers across the UK and Ireland. They're now looking for an Administrator to join their central health and safety function.

The Role

A varied, central admin role with regular contact with colleagues and customers across the business. No health and safety background is required, full training will be given, what matters most is someone organised, reliable and confident enough to represent the department well.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintain the health, safety and environmental management system, including record keeping, policy uploads and reporting
- Oversee the contractor management database and compliance documentation
- Administer training records, certificates and compliance refreshers
- Support ISO certification audits and keep documentation up to date
- Manage the team inbox, raise purchase orders, and take minutes at meetings
- Act as a confident first point of contact for customers and employees

What We're Looking For
- Solid administration experience with strong systems skills (Microsoft Office essential)
- A stable, consistent work history
- A confident, personable communicator
- No health and safety or compliance background required, full training given

The Package
- £26,436.80 to £28,000 DOE, full time, 40 hours per week
- Company bonus scheme
- 5.6 weeks holiday, rising with service
- NEST pension, health cash back plan, and wellbeing programme (physiotherapy, mental health support, remote GP access)
- Cycle to work scheme, holiday purchase scheme, employee discount marketplace
- Free parking, site dependent

title: Service Technical Planner
description:
Job Role: Service Technical Planner

Location: Chesterfield, S41

Our client a well established manufacturing organisation based in Chesterfield is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Service Technical Planner to join their dynamic, friendly Service Administration team.

This exciting role is crucial in ensuring the efficient delivery of contracted service works and reactive breakdowns and repairs, while optimising resource utilisation and maintaining high standards of customer satisfaction.

As a Service Technical Planner, your role will include:
- Validate contracted service jobs prior to scheduling.
- Verify customer details, site access information, and equipment data.
- Determine required engineering competency and resources required.
- Route works to maximise efficiency and minimise travel time.
- Protect diary capacity to accommodate reactive breakdowns.
- Balance engineer workload for strong utilisation.
- Issue complete job packs, including RAMS, stock, and access details.
- Ensure engineers are fully briefed and equipped.
- Communicate schedule updates promptly to relevant parties.
- Support achievement of first-time fix performance.
- Respond promptly to urgent breakdowns in line with SLA requirements.
- Reprioritise schedules when necessary and manage customer expectations during delays.
- Issue certifications promptly and close jobs within the system.
- Track reactive versus planned workload balance and provide performance data to the Service Manager.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives.

Our client is looking for a candidate who embodies the following competencies and experience:
- Strong organisational and planning capabilities.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage competing priorities under pressure.
- Proactive problem-solving and decision-making skills.
- Clear and confident communication skills.
- Analytical mindset focused on efficiency and performance improvement.
- Team-oriented with strong accountability and a robust work ethic.
- Experience in technical scheduling, logistics planning, or field service coordination, preferably within engineering services, utilities, HVAC, telecoms, or similar sectors.
- Proficient in IT, including scheduling systems, CRM software, and route optimisation tools.
- Understanding of service-level agreements and performance metrics.

Working Hours - Monday to Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm office based

If you are a proactive individual with a passion for optimising service delivery and enhancing customer satisfaction, this is an excellent opportunity to advance your career. The organisation offers a supportive environment where your contributions will be valued and recognised.

To apply, please submit your CV detailing your relevant experience. Our client are looking to hire as soon as possible so please do apply today!

description: To provide a comprehensive Outpatient Administration and Main Reception service to the Ilkeston site. This will be to support University Hospitals of Derby and Burton and Derbyshire Community Health Services. To provide a 7-day rostered service to the Community Diagnostic Centre which will include MRI, CT, Ultrasound and Point Of Care Testing. To provide administrative support to the Health Records Department. This involves working closely and communicating effectively with a Multidisciplinary teams using initiative, tact, and diplomacy. We have an opportunity for 25.5 hour posts . This will be a 7am to 7pm service. Flexibility will paramount to this role and for the right candidates we can offer full day shifts or split shifts. You will be joining an already established team who have patient care and outcomes at the heart of everything they do. We offer an excellent working package and free on site parking. This role will require the successful candidate to occasionally work across our local community sites. If you are considering applying for an internal secondment, please ensure you have discussed this with your line manager and obtained their support prior to submitting your application. Please be aware that there is no guarantee that you will be released from your substantive post, so you should seek approval before applying as you are applying or a Secondment. Work on own initiative to ensure the work allocated to the post holder is organised to ensure all deadlines are met, and standards are maintained. To record data, using Lorenzo, SystmOne and the room booking software. To record and update case note folder location details on the case note tracking system. To prepare the contents of case notes in accordance with the case note maintenance policy and prepare items for scanning onto the Patient Administration System (PAS) ensuring information is coded in order to ensure that data can be identified and retrieved as and when required. Provide a courteous and efficient reception service to all Patients attending the hospital, observing confidentiality, overcoming barriers of language and disability etc. Make follow up appointments for outpatients using the PAS system, generating letters, and completing Outpatients Outcomes and Clinical Coding outcomes on the database as required for the Trust Data collection purposes. Ensure the 18-week RTT (referral to treatment) end date is captured on PAS system so that the Trust meets the Government targets. To provide a friendly, helpful, and professional reception service, duties to include cash handling and banking, receipt and distribution of incoming mail, franking and posting.
